text:
maria: Quick brainstorm — we need a crisp benchmark narrative for the launch. Focus: how Redwood's runtime reduces $/token while keeping P95 latency predictable as load grows. Can we land 2 headline charts + one short social animation?

ajay: Agree. My thinking: Chart A = cost-per-1M-tokens vs throughput (req/s) showing improvement from batching + prefix cache. Chart B = tail-latency slices (P50/P95/P99) by request size. Callouts at PLG burst range (100–500 rps).

sam: For Chart B let's slice by seq len 64/256/1024. Show P50,P95,P99 lines. Maybe use a semi-log y-axis for clarity on P99 spikes.

jen: Messaging bullets we can test: 1) "Predictable unit economics at scale" 2) "Latency SLOs with graceful degradation" 3) "Same API across hosted/dedicated/private". Short social hooks should include a quantifiable claim.

eli: I'll mock slides + one-pager. Need the bench CSV with tokens/sec and $/1M for each variant. @ajay can you drop the authoritative numbers? benchbot: results_2026-03-20.csv uploaded to #bench-results.

ajay: Uploading CSV now — gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/bench-172555. Columns: model,seq_len,tokens_per_sec,$_per_1M,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms. Sample row: rw-opt-8b,256,48000,12.4,15,48,210

maria: Nice. Chart color notes: use colorblind-safe palette and plain markers. Micro-copy idea: "Latency-sensitive apps: pick low-latency variant; cost-first apps: pick quantized+cache variant."

sam: Webinar plan: 20 min demo (runtime internals + live benchmark run) + 10 min Q&A. Target: infra/platform engineers. CTA: "Run these benchmarks on your workload" -> upload sample + quick lead form. Need SDR routing rules for leads >50k monthly tokens.

jen: Social hooks (short): "Cut inference bills, not quality — see how we shave per-token cost while preserving tail latency." Longer: "Demo: real workloads, same API, predictable economics."

maria: Assignments: eli = slides + demo (due Thu), ajay = cleaned CSV & chart-friendly CSV (due Wed noon), jen = social copy + CTA flows (due Wed EOD), sam = webinar ops + SDR routing doc (due Thu EOD). I'll assemble the one-pager. Any objections?

ajay: No objections. Also adding a tiny smoke-test snippet for the docs: 
```bash
curl -s https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-opt-8b","input":"short"}'
```

maria: Perfect. Two last asks: 1) include a small table in the PR deck with expected % cost delta vs baseline, 2) add overlay annotations explaining where cache/batching kick in on Chart A.

benchbot: Noted — will ping when slides + chart PNGs are uploaded to the drive.

eli: I'll start mocks tonight and post a sneak preview tomorrow morning.

maria: Thanks team. Keeping it tight — we want a single-page narrative that ties charts -> messaging -> webinar CTA -> inbound routing. :rocket:
